title: Title card burned into the talking-head edit
caption: A title card burned into the top of the talking-head edit with mgvideo title: the name and a one-line subtitle on a dark rounded card that stays on screen for the whole clip.
prompt: Burn a title card into 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2 s to 9 s): "Meet Mira from Magnifito" with the subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia", placed at the top so it does not cover her face or the captions. Keep the audio and save it as work/titled.mp4.
commands: mgvideo title work/source.mp4 --title "Meet Mira from Magnifito" --subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia" --position top --out work/titled.mp4
